content.text: The workspace invite modal traps focus for keyboard users as intended, but pressing Escape does not close it. Overlay click and the X button still work.

Escape should dismiss the modal and restore focus to the Invite trigger. The dialog registers a keydown listener on the modal node only; when focus is inside a nested focusable (email input), the event does not bubble to that listener because stopPropagation runs on the input enter-to-add-chip handler for all keys.

Keyboard-only admins cannot bail out without Tabbing to the close control. Moving Escape handling to document while the modal is mounted (and ignoring it when a nested popover is open) restores expected dialog behavior.
